#### Authors: *Brian Schilder, Alan Murphy, Julien Bryois, Hiranyamaya (Hiru) Dash, Nathan Skene*

#### README updated: *Jan-26-2026*

## Introduction

This R package contains code used for testing which cell types can
explain the heritability signal from GWAS summary statistics. The method
was described in our [2018 Nature Genetics
paper](https://www.nature.com/articles/s41588-018-0129-5).

This package takes GWAS summary statistics + single-cell transcriptome
specificity data (in [EWCE](https://github.com/NathanSkene/EWCE)’s
CellTypeData format) as input. It then calculates and returns the
enrichment between the GWAS trait and the cell-types.

## Installation

### R

Install `MAGMA.Celltyping` as follows:

``` r

if(!require("remotes")) install.packages("remotes")

remotes::install_github("neurogenomics/MAGMA_Celltyping")
library(MAGMA.Celltyping)
```

### MAGMA

`MAGMA.Celltyping` now installs the command line software MAGMA
automatically when you first use a function that relies on
[MAGMA](https://ctg.cncr.nl/software/magma)
(e.g. `celltype_associations_pipeline`). If you prefer, you can later
install other versions of MAGMA with:

``` r

MAGMA.Celltyping::install_magma(desired_version="<version>",
                                update = TRUE)
```

## Using older versions

With the release of `MAGMA.Celltyping` 2.0 in January 2022, there have
been a number of [major updates and bug
fixes](https://github.com/neurogenomics/MAGMA_Celltyping/pull/93).

- Only R\>4.0.0 is supported. To use this package with older versions of
  R, install
  with:`remotes::install_github("neurogenomics/MAGMA_Celltyping@01a9e53")`

## Bugs/fixes

Having trouble? Search the
[Issues](https://github.com/neurogenomics/MAGMA_Celltyping/issues) or
submit a new one.

Want to contribute new features/fixes? [Pull
Requests](https://github.com/neurogenomics/MAGMA_Celltyping/pulls) are
welcomed!

Both are most welcome, we want the package to be easy to use for
everyone!

## Citations

If you use the software then please cite:

> [Skene, et al. Genetic identification of brain cell types underlying
> schizophrenia. Nature Genetics,
> 2018.](https://www.nature.com/articles/s41588-018-0129-5)

The package utilises the [MAGMA](https://ctg.cncr.nl/software/magma)
software developed in the Complex Trait Genetics Lab at VU university
(not us!) so please also cite:

> [de Leeuw, et al. MAGMA: Generalized gene-set analysis of GWAS data.
> PLoS Comput Biol,
> 2015.](https://journals.plos.org/ploscompbiol/article?id=10.1371%2Fjournal.pcbi.1004219)

If you use the EWCE package as well then please cite:

> [Skene, et al. Identification of Vulnerable Cell Types in Major Brain
> Disorders Using Single Cell Transcriptomes and Expression Weighted
> Cell Type Enrichment. Front. Neurosci,
> 2016.](https://www.frontiersin.org/articles/10.3389/fnins.2016.00016/full)

If you use `MungeSumstats` to format your summary statistics then please
cite:

> [Murphy, Schilder, & Skene, MungeSumstats: a Bioconductor package for
> the standardization and quality control of many GWAS summary
> statistics, Bioinformatics, Volume 37, Issue 23, 1 December 2021,
> Pages 4593–4596,
> https://doi.org/10.1093/bioinformatics/btab665](https://doi.org/10.1093/bioinformatics/btab665)

If you use the cortex/hippocampus single cell data associated with this
package then please cite the following papers:

> [Zeisel, et al. Cell types in the mouse cortex and hippocampus
> revealed by single-cell RNA-seq. Science,
> 2015.](https://doi.org/10.1126/science.aaa1934)

If you use the midbrain and hypothalamus single cell datasets associated
with the 2018 paper then please cite the following papers:

> [La Manno, et al. Molecular Diversity of Midbrain Development in
> Mouse, Human, and Stem Cells. Cell,
> 2016.](https://doi.org/10.1016/j.cell.2016.09.027)

> [Romanov, et al. Molecular interrogation of hypothalamic organization
> reveals distinct dopamine neuronal subtypes. Nature Neuroscience,
> 2016.](https://doi.org/10.1038/nn.4462)

# Package index

## All functions

- [`adjust_zstat_in_genesOut()`](https://neurogenomics.github.io/MAGMA_Celltyping/reference/adjust_zstat_in_genesOut.md)
  :

  Adjust MAGMA Z-statistic from *.genes.out* files

- [`calculate_celltype_associations()`](https://neurogenomics.github.io/MAGMA_Celltyping/reference/calculate_celltype_associations.md)
  : Calculate celltype associations using MAGMA

- [`calculate_celltype_enrichment_limma()`](https://neurogenomics.github.io/MAGMA_Celltyping/reference/calculate_celltype_enrichment_limma.md)
  : Calculate celltype enrichment

- [`calculate_conditional_celltype_associations()`](https://neurogenomics.github.io/MAGMA_Celltyping/reference/calculate_conditional_celltype_associations.md)
  : Calculate conditional celltype associations using MAGMA

- [`calculate_conditional_celltype_enrichment_limma()`](https://neurogenomics.github.io/MAGMA_Celltyping/reference/calculate_conditional_celltype_enrichment_limma.md)
  : Calculate celltype enrichments without MAGMA

- [`calculate_conditional_geneset_enrichment()`](https://neurogenomics.github.io/MAGMA_Celltyping/reference/calculate_conditional_geneset_enrichment.md)
  : Use MAGMA to test enrichment in a geneset

- [`calculate_geneset_enrichment()`](https://neurogenomics.github.io/MAGMA_Celltyping/reference/calculate_geneset_enrichment.md)
  : Use MAGMA to test enrichment in a geneset

- [`celltype_associations_pipeline()`](https://neurogenomics.github.io/MAGMA_Celltyping/reference/celltype_associations_pipeline.md)
  : Calculate cell type associations using MAGMA

- [`compare_trait_enrichments()`](https://neurogenomics.github.io/MAGMA_Celltyping/reference/compare_trait_enrichments.md)
  : Test to see which cell types are more enriched in magmaPath2 than
  magmaPath1

- [`create_DT()`](https://neurogenomics.github.io/MAGMA_Celltyping/reference/create_DT.md)
  : Create data table

- [`drop_genes_within_mhc()`](https://neurogenomics.github.io/MAGMA_Celltyping/reference/drop_genes_within_mhc.md)
  : Drop genes within MHC

- [`enrichment_results`](https://neurogenomics.github.io/MAGMA_Celltyping/reference/enrichment_results.md)
  : Example celltype enrichment results

- [`format_sumstats_for_magma()`](https://neurogenomics.github.io/MAGMA_Celltyping/reference/format_sumstats_for_magma.md)
  : Format GWAS summary statistics

- [`get_ctd()`](https://neurogenomics.github.io/MAGMA_Celltyping/reference/get_ctd.md)
  : Import precomputed CellTypeDatasets

- [`get_driver_genes()`](https://neurogenomics.github.io/MAGMA_Celltyping/reference/get_driver_genes.md)
  :

  Get genes driving significant MAGMA_celltyping results

- [`get_example_gwas()`](https://neurogenomics.github.io/MAGMA_Celltyping/reference/get_example_gwas.md)
  : Import GWAS summary statistics

- [`get_genome_ref()`](https://neurogenomics.github.io/MAGMA_Celltyping/reference/get_genome_ref.md)
  : Download genome ref

- [`get_genomebuild_for_sumstats()`](https://neurogenomics.github.io/MAGMA_Celltyping/reference/get_genomebuild_for_sumstats.md)
  : Get genome build for sumstats

- [`get_magma_paths()`](https://neurogenomics.github.io/MAGMA_Celltyping/reference/get_magma_paths.md)
  : Get MAGMA Paths

- [`gwas_munged`](https://neurogenomics.github.io/MAGMA_Celltyping/reference/gwas_munged.md)
  : Munged GWAS

- [`hgnc2entrez_orthogene`](https://neurogenomics.github.io/MAGMA_Celltyping/reference/hgnc2entrez_orthogene.md)
  : HGNC to Entrez symbol mapping

- [`import_magma_files()`](https://neurogenomics.github.io/MAGMA_Celltyping/reference/import_magma_files.md)
  : Import preprocessed MAGMA files

- [`infer_ctd_species()`](https://neurogenomics.github.io/MAGMA_Celltyping/reference/infer_ctd_species.md)
  : Infer CellTypeDataset species

- [`infer_geneset_species()`](https://neurogenomics.github.io/MAGMA_Celltyping/reference/infer_geneset_species.md)
  : Infer gene set species

- [`list_snps_to_genes_files()`](https://neurogenomics.github.io/MAGMA_Celltyping/reference/list_snps_to_genes_files.md)
  : List SNPs-to-genes mapping files

- [`load_magma_results_file()`](https://neurogenomics.github.io/MAGMA_Celltyping/reference/load_magma_results_file.md)
  : Load a MAGMA .gcov.out file

- [`magma_files_metadata`](https://neurogenomics.github.io/MAGMA_Celltyping/reference/magma_files_metadata.md)
  : MAGMA_Files_Public: metadata

- [`magma_install()`](https://neurogenomics.github.io/MAGMA_Celltyping/reference/magma_install.md)
  : Install the MAGMA command line tool

- [`magma_links_stored`](https://neurogenomics.github.io/MAGMA_Celltyping/reference/magma_links_stored.md)
  : Stored links to MAGMA executables

- [`magma_run()`](https://neurogenomics.github.io/MAGMA_Celltyping/reference/magma_run.md)
  : Run MAGMA

- [`magma_tileplot()`](https://neurogenomics.github.io/MAGMA_Celltyping/reference/magma_tileplot.md)
  : MAGMA tile plot

- [`magma_uninstall()`](https://neurogenomics.github.io/MAGMA_Celltyping/reference/magma_uninstall.md)
  : Uninstall MAGMA

- [`map_snps_to_genes()`](https://neurogenomics.github.io/MAGMA_Celltyping/reference/map_snps_to_genes.md)
  : Map SNPs to their nearby genes

- [`merge_magma_results()`](https://neurogenomics.github.io/MAGMA_Celltyping/reference/merge_magma_results.md)
  : Merge MAGMA results

- [`merge_results()`](https://neurogenomics.github.io/MAGMA_Celltyping/reference/merge_results.md)
  : Gather enrichment results

- [`plot_celltype_associations()`](https://neurogenomics.github.io/MAGMA_Celltyping/reference/plot_celltype_associations.md)
  : Plot celltype associations calculated using MAGMA

- [`prepare_quantile_groups()`](https://neurogenomics.github.io/MAGMA_Celltyping/reference/prepare_quantile_groups.md)
  : Prepare quantile groups for each celltype based on specificity

- [`rbfox_binding`](https://neurogenomics.github.io/MAGMA_Celltyping/reference/rbfox_binding.md)
  : Rbfox binding genes in MGI format

- [`results_barplot()`](https://neurogenomics.github.io/MAGMA_Celltyping/reference/results_barplot.md)
  : Plot barplot of enrichment results - plotting -log10 (p-value) but
  cut-off significance is based on FDR where if either linear or top10
  FDR threshold the result will be plotted

- [`results_heatmap()`](https://neurogenomics.github.io/MAGMA_Celltyping/reference/results_heatmap.md)
  : Plot heatmap of enrichment results

- [`standardise.sumstats.column.headers()`](https://neurogenomics.github.io/MAGMA_Celltyping/reference/standardise.sumstats.column.headers.md)
  : Standardise the column headers in the Summary Statistics files
